verdict.rationale: The evidence only shows feedback intake automation: customer feedback is turned into issues that are routed, labeled and prioritized, and Slack Asks are linked to customers. Nothing documents user-built workflows that trigger SLAs, trial extensions or discount offers from feedback events. The GraphQL API and agent platform are developer building blocks, not the capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can build automated workflows for SLAs, trial extensions, and discount offers triggered by feedback events
